notes: HomeStop is Shoppers Stop's home vertical, living at categoryPath1='Home' inside the shared shoppersstop.com marketplace (brand page /brand/HomeStop, department landing /category/Homestop). No separate homestop.com or homestop.in domain exists; this IS the vertical. robots.txt explicitly Allows ClaudeBot/Claude-User (only /checkout,/cart,/login,/account,/orders,/payment disallowed), so direct fetch was used throughout, no WAF bypass needed. Access route: the site is a Next.js SPA whose __NEXT_DATA__ embeds Unbxd (Mimir) search-as-a-service prefetches; the SSR-embedded product/facet JSON only reflects a single categoryPath1 filter (client-side JS applies the rest, which this fetch cannot execute), so category counts were obtained by calling the underlying Unbxd search API directly at https://search.unbxd.io/579c6c9e792e43e038e7f40ca11b6103/ss-unbxd-aapac-shoppersstop-dev50901709028198/search with repeated filter= params (categoryPath1_uFilter/categoryPath2_uFilter/categoryPath3_uFilter/pro_type_uFilter, AND-combined) and rows=0+facet.multiselect=true to read exact facet counts -- this is the site's own live search index, not a scraped/rounded widget. All 9 Home-department categoryPath2 buckets were enumerated (Bedding 1905, Dining 1460, Living 1259, Kitchen 936, Decor ~853-856 [fluctuates live], Bath & Laundry 749, Home & Kitchen Appliances 33, Accessories 25 [Umbrella only], Music Collections 2 [HYBE albums, miscategorised/irrelevant]) so the department is exhaustively covered, not just guessed at. SCOPE STRICTLY LIMITED to Home/Decor navigation per instructions; Fashion/Beauty/Watches/Gifts nav branches on shoppersstop.com were not touched. Rule-0 check: keyword searches for mirror/clock/chandelier/lighting within categoryPath1=Home confirm HomeStop carries NO dedicated Mirrors or Clocks category (mirror hits are incidental mirror-work embroidery on cushions, not glass mirrors; clock search returns 0) -- true absence, not a missed category. Exclusions applied at categoryPath3/pro_type grain using each bucket's own exact facet count (leaf rows sum in-scope pro_type facet values against the parent categoryPath3 total, both numbers taken directly from the live API, and cross-checked against the categoryPath3-level total which matched exactly in every case below): Bedding (all textiles: Bed Sheets/Quilts/Pillows/Covers), Living (all textiles/furniture: Curtains/Cushions/Floor Coverings/Ottomans/Sofa Covers), Kitchen (Storage Solution/Cookware & Bakeware/Food Preps & Tools/Table & Kitchen Linens -- all excluded, no glassware/dinnerware filed here, that lives under Dining), Home & Kitchen Appliances (excluded wholesale), Accessories (Umbrella only, excluded), Music Collections (excluded, irrelevant). Within Dining: Cutlery (220) and Table Linens (56) excluded wholesale; within Dinnerware, Baking Tools(1)+Dish Racks(1) dropped; within Drinkware, Bar Accessories(31) is a genuine mixed bucket (bottle/corkscrew openers mixed with tumblers/dessert glasses, titles inspected, no further facet to split it) so DROPPED per mixed-roll-up rule rather than padded; within Table Tops, Kitchen Organizers(16)/Trivets(3)/Baskets(2)/Ice Trays(1) dropped as functional kitchen items after title inspection, Trays/Coasters/Tissue Box Holders(decorative MDF/wood/leather)/Condiment Sets kept. Within Decor: Fragrance Candles and Holders (382-ish, fluctuates) is a mixed bucket -- only Candle Holders and Lanterns pro_types kept (titles confirm genuine glass/metal candle holders and tealight lanterns); plain 'Candles' pro_type dropped wholesale (titles show it is dominated by scented/wax-melt SKUs with only rare unscented ones mixed in, no further facet split available, so dropped per mixed-roll-up rule rather than guessed); Reed Diffusers/Aroma Oils/Electrical Diffusers/Incense/Potpourris/Oil Diffusers/Aroma Sets excluded as Home Fragrance. Vases & Flowers: Artificial Flowers(80) dropped (faux flowers excluded by scope), Table Vases+Floor Vases kept. Garden: Potted Arrangements(132) dropped after title inspection showed it is almost entirely faux/artificial potted plants (brand 'Everera'); Showpieces(3, decorative fountains -- Ganesha/elephant/Buddha fountains) kept. Idols & Figurines, Wall Decor (Paintings+Showpieces+Wall Decors), Decor Accents kept in full (titles confirm genuine decorative sculptures/wall art/table accents). Lamps(2, Table Lamps) filed under category=Lighting per Rule 0 even though the site nests it under Decor>Lamps. Bath & Laundry: Towels/Shower Curtains/Soaps/Toilet Brush & Holders/Bath & Shower Sets/Laundry/Cleaning excluded; the generic 'Bath Accessories' pro_type (80 items) is a genuine mixed bucket of decorative ceramic/polyresin bathroom sets (soap dishes, tumblers, toothbrush caddies) plus a few shower/bath mats with no further facet to split cleanly, so left null+flagged for manual review rather than guessed -- this is the only qty:null row and is why status is 'partial' not 'ok'. Duplicate-company determination: grepped pipeline/json_archive (281 files) for shoppersstop/shoppers stop/homestop -- no prior extraction found, this is a new company, not a duplicate of any earlier S.N.
